data.one_liner: Read and write INI configuration files in pure Dart
data.what_it_does: The package parses INI files into a Config object and can serialize a Config back to a string. It supports sections, options, and default section handling.
use_when: You need to load or modify INI files in a Dart or Flutter project
You want a lightweight, dependency‑free solution for configuration files
avoid_when: You need advanced parsing features like interpolation or nested sections
You are targeting only JSON or YAML configuration formats
strengths: Simple API for reading, writing, and manipulating sections and options
Works on all supported platforms (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: No support for complex INI features (e.g., multiline values, comments preservation)
No code generation or declarative configuration support
No built‑in validation or schema enforcement
